name: gym-bro
description: Read Gym Bro fitness records and save requested routines, food, water and measurements.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Gym Bro account to find exercises, read routines and workout history, and summarize training, nutrition and hydration. Save training programs, routines, custom exercises, food diary entries, drinking water and actual body measurements when you ask. Account limits apply: Free includes limited routine and custom-exercise capacity and a restricted nutrition and hydration date window; Pro unlocks additional access. Free and Pro access follow your Gym Bro account. Pro purchases take place in the mobile app through its app store. An authenticated Gym Bro account is required. The connection does not update or delete records, control live workouts, change nutrition goals or access social features.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my training for the last seven days.
Show my hydration total for today.

prompts: Find chest exercises I can do with a barbell.
Save two glasses of water, 250 ml each, for now.
Save my current weight as 72.5 kg.
Find oats in my food catalog.
review.commerce_description: Gym Bro offers Free and Pro tiers. Pro is purchased through in-app payments in the corresponding mobile app and app store; access is tied to the connected Gym Bro account.

positive.description: Find exercises in English and Italian. Setup: Connected dedicated test account; standard exercise catalog available. No private fixtures required.
positive.prompt: Find chest exercises I can do with a barbell. Show their names and references.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_exercises with query and/or muscle/equipment filters derived from the request. Show only returned exercises and source/id references. Do not create any records.

positive.description: Read saved routines. Setup: Dedicated account has at least one active routine containing an exercise with sets; use IDs returned by list_routines.
positive.prompt: Show my saved routines, then open the first one and explain its exercises and sets.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_routines and get_routine with an id returned by the list. Explain the returned ordered entries, sets, units and notes; follow pagination if needed and never invent a routine.

positive.description: Training totals. Setup: Dedicated account contains at least one saved workout in that UTC interval. Resolve actual dates at execution and include both endpoints.
positive.prompt: Summarize my completed workouts for the last seven calendar days, including completed sets and volume in kilograms.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_training_stats with explicit from/to covering the requested UTC dates and weightUnit=kg. Report totals supported by returned fields; distinguish an empty interval from an error. No forecasts or writes.

positive.description: Record water with exact unit conversion. Setup: Dedicated test account, account timezone known, Free or Pro; today within allowed dates. This case writes sample data and must run only on that test account.
positive.prompt: Save two glasses of water, 250 ml each, for now, then show my hydration total for today.
positive.expected_behavior: Call log_water with one entry milliliters=500, omit time for server time, and a UUID idempotencyKey. On retry reuse the same key and payload. Then call get_hydration_summary for today in the account timezone. Report saved IDs and returned totals; do not assert a preexisting total or double-count.

positive.description: Save actual body measurements. Setup: Dedicated test account; explicit request to save actual sample measurements. This case writes data only to that account.
positive.prompt: Save my current weight as 72.5 kg and body fat as 18 percent.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_measurements with a UUID idempotencyKey and entries [{kind:weight,value:72.5,unit:kg},{kind:body,type:bodyFat,value:18}], omitting time for server time. Confirm only persisted records returned; no prediction or duplicate retry writes.

positive.description: Log a manual sample food and verify its quantity and nutrient totals. Setup: Dedicated test account with an empty food diary for today in its account timezone; use synthetic demo values, never a real person’s diet. No public food-catalog publication or external fixture is required.
positive.prompt: Save 30 g of Demo oats to my food diary for today. These are synthetic test values per 100 g: 380 kcal, 7 g fat, 1.3 g saturated fat, 60 g carbs, 1 g sugar and 13 g protein. Then show today’s nutrition totals.
positive.expected_behavior: Call log_foods with a UUID idempotencyKey, date=today in the account timezone, amount=30, pieces=1 and a manual food named Demo oats, unit=g, with the six supplied per-100g values. Optional nutrients remain unknown, not invented zeros. Reuse the same key and identical payload on retry. Then call get_nutrition_summary with from=to=today. With the stated empty-diary setup, totals should reflect 114 kcal, 2.1 g fat, 0.39 g saturated fat, 18 g carbs, 0.3 g sugar and 3.9 g protein (allow numeric rounding). Confirm only actual persisted results. Do not publish a catalog entry.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion. Deletion and workout-history writes are unsupported. Explain the limit and direct the user to the app; invoke no deletion, creation, logging or other mutating tool and do not claim data was deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete every saved workout in my account.

negative.description: Unsupported live recording. Live watch/workout controls are unsupported. Explain that recording must be controlled in the app/watch; do not invoke any tool or claim a workout or timer started.
negative.prompt: Start recording a workout on my watch now and pause it after ten minutes.

negative.description: Unsupported account settings edits. Nutrition goal/category edits are unsupported. Explain how to make changes in the app without invoking logging or creation tools and without claiming settings changed.
negative.prompt: Change my daily calorie goal to 2200 and rename my breakfast category to Morning.

publication.release_notes: Initial public plugin package for the existing Gym Bro account connection: exercise lookup, routines, workout history, nutrition, hydration and actual body measurements.
